messages:
alec: Heads-up — planning the cross-service change window 02:00 UTC for API/runtime/console/router. Need final pin + rollback checklist by 01:10 UTC.

sophia: Ack. console has a pinned schema change (v1.43.2 -> v1.44.x) — holding at v1.43.2 until after canary.

raj: Rollback criteria proposal: router error-rate > 2% sustained for 5m OR p99 latency increase > 200ms over baseline for 10m. If triggered, cut traffic back to previous pinned variant and abort rollout.

alec: That matches my thinking. Also: API and runtime must keep compatibility with the console pin. Will we allow runtime minor (v2.8.x) while console stays v1.43.2?

sophia: Yes, runtime accepts both v1.43.2 and v1.44.x console shapes — tested in staging. API team will stay on blue group (no schema bump).

deploybot: Deploywave scheduled: 2024-10-15T02:00:00Z by @alec. Plan: canary 2% for 15m -> 10% for 10m -> 100%. Automatic rollback enabled based on alert rules.

devex: I added a short release-notes stub and compatibility notes: https://redwood-internal/release-notes/2024-10-15
Please add any consumer-facing incompatibility lines before 01:30 UTC.

oncall-sre: I created the alert rule and linked it to the deploybot abort. Rule: `sum(rate(router_errors[5m])) / sum(rate(router_requests[5m])) > 0.02` and p99 latency check on `router_request_duration_seconds`. Will mute noisy infra alerts during canary.

sam: Quick FYI — KV eviction tweak landed into runtime candidate. I will hold the runtime pin if any instability shows; otherwise will flip at step->10% canary. If I don't post an update by 01:00 UTC, assume hold and we abort.

alec: OK — contingency: if sam holds, we delay traffic shift for 30m and then re-evaluate. If still unresolved, we rollback to prior pins. I'll note that in the release notes.

raj: Add explicit manual rollback trigger: `- /deploybot rollback --to-tag=stable-20241014` in runbook.

deploybot: preflight checks: all services report compatible models, no schema mismatches. Canary bundles created.

deploybot: deploy started at 02:00:05Z — canary 2% (router: shard-a). Logs: 
```
[02:00:07] router: canary shard-a assigned
[02:00:08] api: canary endpoints healthy
[02:05:15] runtime: kv eviction monitor OK
```

devex: small docs note added about the console pin and rollback instructions.

oncall-sre: Monitoring: first 10m stable, p99 within +30ms, errors <0.5%. Holding for 15m canary.

sam: All good from runtime side — no eviction spikes. Releasing hold at 02:15.

alec: Thanks everyone. If anything changes call the rollback channel. I'll follow up with a short postmortem template in #eng-releases after the window. :thumbsup:
